note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 General Dynamics Land Systems Stryker Combat Vehicles datasheet, with the tier-5 English Wikipedia article retained for the fields the datasheet does not publish. The registry marks the datasheet primary_held true; the held bytes are the GDLS PDF. The datasheet publishes the 350 HP Caterpillar 3126 diesel engine, the eight-wheel running gear, the governed top speed, the cruising range and the combat and shipping height, width and length of the Infantry Carrier Vehicle. Those fields are grade claimed at the manufacturer tier. The datasheet publishes no weight, no ground clearance, no tyre size and no transmission class, so the mass, ground clearance and transmission fields remain absent or on the tier-5 compilation at grade claimed. Where the Wikipedia engine model or speed disagrees with the datasheet, both are recorded and neither is averaged.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Infobox, Specifications section, Mass row, ICV entry
operating_weight_kg.state: mass published for the ICV variant as 18.16 short tons (16.47 t); recorded as 16,470 kg with the tonne taken as 1,000 kg; the same row publishes the MGS mass as a separate configuration and the article states no kerb, combat or gross state for either; the held tier-4 GDLS datasheet publishes no weight

length_mm.locator: Infantry Carrier Vehicle panel, combat column, length
length_mm.state: Infantry Carrier Vehicle combat length published as 286.3 in; converted as 286.3 x 25.4 mm = 7,272 mm; the same row publishes the shipping length as 286.5 in

width_mm.locator: Infantry Carrier Vehicle panel, combat column, width
width_mm.state: Infantry Carrier Vehicle combat width published as 116.43 in; converted as 116.43 x 25.4 mm = 2,957 mm; the same row publishes the shipping width as 112.8 in

height_mm.locator: Infantry Carrier Vehicle panel, combat column, height
height_mm.state: Infantry Carrier Vehicle combat height published as 122.88 in; converted as 122.88 x 25.4 mm = 3,121 mm; the same row publishes the shipping height as 103.6 in

engine_model.state: engine published as a Caterpillar 3126 diesel; the tier-5 English Wikipedia infobox publishes Caterpillar C7 for a later mark, so the two sources disagree and neither is averaged

published_power_hp.state: engine published as 350 HP, with no net basis stated; the tier-5 English Wikipedia infobox also publishes 350 hp

max_speed_kmh.state: governed top speed published as 62.5 mph; converted as 62.5 x 1.609344 km/h = 100.6 km/h; the tier-5 English Wikipedia infobox publishes 97 km/h for a variant, so the two sources disagree and neither is averaged

range_km.state: cruising range published as 330 mi; converted as 330 x 1.609344 km = 531 km; the datasheet states no load or road state for the figure

wheel_count.state: vehicle published as an eight-wheel, run-flat and central tyre inflation system vehicle
